subject: science
concept: Designing and safely conducting a simple mixture or reaction investigation
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs and runs a simple, safe mixing investigation and records observations
exercise.pictorial: Student charts their observations using a simple before/after graphic
exercise.abstract: Student states whether their investigation showed a physical or chemical change, with evidence

assessment.mastery_threshold: conclusion is supported by actual recorded observations
misconception_flags: states a conclusion contradicted by their own recorded observations

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
